description: Helper functions and test scripts for managing and testing Git commit-graphs, including cache initialization, traversal testing, and read expectation checks.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Initializes the OID cache with different version entries.

methods.name: graph_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares git operations run with core.commitGraph enabled and disabled to ensure consistency.

methods.name: graph_git_behavior
methods.description: Runs a series of git commands to verify behavior consistency across different graph modes for a given branch, directory, and comparison target.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for read-graph operations and verifies actual output matches expectations.
